spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ऋ) एषृ (एषते)
To go or approach.

f. (-षा)
Desire.
E.
इष to wish, अङ् and टाप् affs.

m. (-णः)
An iron arrow.
f. (-णी)
1 A goldsmith's balance, assay scales.
2 An iron or steel probe.
E.
एष to go, ल्युट् and ङीष् affs.

f. (-का)
A goldsmith's balance.
E.
as before, with कन् and टाप् added.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be desired, desirable.
2 To be aimed at.
E.
इष to wish, affix अनीयर्.
